title: 2-Ingredient Tofu Naan! 🫓 (High-Protein & No-Yeast)
description:
2-INGREDIENT TOFU NAAN 🫓✨ (No yeast, no waiting!)
If you love fresh, warm, pillowy bread but don’t have the time (or patience!) for yeast to rise, you have to try this. All you need is a block of soft tofu and self-rising flour.
Yes, really! The tofu makes these flatbreads unbelievably soft, keeps them fresh for longer, and sneaks in a wonderful boost of plant-based protein and calcium for the family.
Save this for your next busy weeknight! 👇
Ingredients:
 300g soft tofu (or silken tofu)
 300g to 350g self-rising flour (Tip: If using normal flour, use 350g flour + 4 tsp baking powder + a pinch of salt!)
 Butter or vegan butter for brushing
Method:
1. In a bowl, mash the soft tofu with a fork.
2. Add your flour and salt, then knead gently until a soft dough forms.
3. Divide into 8 small balls and roll them out on a floured surface.
4. Cook on a hot cast-iron skillet for a couple of minutes on each side until golden and bubbly.
5. Brush with melted butter and enjoy warm!
